whatIs.title: What is Padbol Match
whatIs.text: It connects players and venues. It brings together competition, community and management. Every match creates continuity: not just a booking tool, but a relationship that continues after you play.

status.title: What you can use today and what comes next
status.text: We clearly show what is already available, what is rolling out, and what belongs to the next stage.

active.title: The Padbol journey
active.text: Sign in, profiles, bookings, open matches, tournaments, ranking, and community with photos and videos.

rollingOut.title: New sports and scoreboard
rollingOut.text: Padel, Pickleball and Tennis; the smart scoreboard and external level recognition are enabled gradually and validated through real play.

next.title: Commercial layers
next.text: Sponsor spaces, advertising managed by each venue, and a dedicated e-shop for products and benefits.

playerPath.title: For players
playerPath.text: Find matches, create games, join open slots, book, compete and follow your progress inside the community.

find.title: Find matches
find.text: Discover nearby games and chances to play.

book.title: Book
book.text: Secure court time at your venue.

compete.title: Compete
compete.text: Tournaments, teams and results that count.

create.title: Create a match
create.text: Set venue, time and level to invite players.

join.title: Open matches
join.text: Request a spot, complete teams and confirm your place.

evolve.title: Track your progress
evolve.text: History, ranking and growth in your profile.

venuePath.title: For venues and organizations
venuePath.text: Create new matches, fill schedules, activate players and turn open games into real occupancy, with smart scoreboard and continuity.

scoreboard.title: Smart scoreboard
scoreboard.text: Record the match live and connect it to venue operations.

occupy.title: Real occupancy
occupy.text: Open matches and bookings that fill courts and empty slots.

activate.title: Activate players
activate.text: Your venue community finds someone to play with and comes back.

continuity.title: Continuity
continuity.text: Tournaments, ranking, PadCoins and memberships after every game.

continuity.title: Before, during and after
continuity.text: Every match can become history, competition, progress and a new reason to return. Open matches, results, ranking, PadCoins, memberships and community reinforce each other.

experiences.title: Five experiences. One platform.
experiences.text: The same play and management base, five visual identities.

expansion.title: The ecosystem keeps growing
expansion.text: New commercial layers for venues, brands and the Padbol community.

eshop.title: E-shop
eshop.text: Products and benefits connected to the venue.

expansion.note: Areas in development within the Padbol Match ecosystem.

about.title: About us
about.text: Padbol Match comes from the sport of Padbol and grows as an international platform for players, venues and organizations.

communityMatches.title: Playing starts before you walk on court.
communityMatches.text: Padbol Match lets you create matches, find players, join open games and complete teams in one community. Venues gain real activity when the intent to play is confirmed.

smartScoreboard.text: The result is recorded while you play and stays connected to history, competition and venue activity. Sets, partials and corrections serve the match and what comes next.
